a.lede: The AI company behind the Claude chatbot will offer its shares at between $70 and $78.
a.title: Anthropic heads for $1.3 trillion valuation in major stock market listing

b.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share to reach an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion
